Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a dynamic chemical enterprise based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, with its office located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang. Situated in one of China’s most economically vibrant and innovative regions, the company benefits from a strong industrial foundation, convenient transportation networks, and access to advanced research and manufacturing resources. These advantages support Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. in its ongoing commitment to delivering high-quality chemical products and new material solutions to a broad range of industries.

As a company operating in the chemical and new materials sector, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is positioned within an industry that plays a vital role in modern manufacturing and technological development. Chemical new materials are essential for applications across textiles, construction, personal care, industrial processing, coatings, electronics, and many other fields. By focusing on quality, innovation, and practical application, the company aims to meet evolving market demands while contributing to industrial progress and product performance enhancement.

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. reflects the strengths commonly associated with leading Zhejiang-based enterprises: market responsiveness, technical development capability, and a strong emphasis on customer-oriented service. In today’s highly competitive global market, chemical companies must not only provide reliable products but also maintain consistency, safety awareness, and adaptability. Runhe Chemical New Material seeks to build long-term value by combining professional expertise with modern business practices and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Located in Hangzhou, a city well known for its blend of commercial vitality, technological advancement, and international connectivity, the company is well placed to serve both domestic and overseas customers. Its strategic location enables it to stay closely connected with suppliers, partners, and clients, while also supporting efficient communication and collaboration. This geographic advantage, together with a focus on innovation and quality, helps strengthen the company’s role in the chemical new materials market.

Overall, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. represents a modern Chinese chemical company dedicated to growth, product development, and customer satisfaction. With its Hangzhou base, industry focus, and commitment to high standards, the company continues to pursue opportunities in the chemical and new materials field while working to build a trusted and forward-looking business presence.
